privacyNote.en: Only anonymized development and feedback-resolution progress is published here. Private feedback, email addresses and personal information are never published.
privacyNote.zh-CN: 这里只公布匿名化的开发进度与反馈处理结果，不会公开用户原始反馈、邮箱或其他个人信息。

title.zh-CN: 视频收藏库与视频内笔记

summary.en: Organize saved videos and links in collections, and add notes at specific moments while watching.
summary.zh-CN: 将保存的视频和链接整理到收藏夹，并在观看时为指定时间点添加笔记。

details.en: Implemented in the development build. The public release date has not been confirmed.
details.zh-CN: 开发版本已实现，公开发布的具体时间尚未确定。

releaseLabel.zh-CN: 开发已完成 · 待发布

title.en: Picture in Picture and background audio

summary.en: Implemented for local videos and supported direct video URLs. These capabilities are not promised for embedded YouTube playback.
summary.zh-CN: 已针对本地视频和受支持的视频直链实现。YouTube 内嵌播放不承诺支持这些功能。

details.en: Implemented for local and supported direct-link videos in the development build; availability will depend on the public app release. YouTube embedded playback is excluded.
details.zh-CN: 开发版本已实现本地视频及受支持直链的画中画和后台音频；用户何时可以使用取决于正式版本发布。YouTube 内嵌播放不包含在内。

releaseLabel.zh-CN: 开发已完成 · 待发布

title.en: YouTube link previews and embedded playback
title.zh-CN: YouTube 链接预览与内嵌播放

summary.en: Save YouTube links with available metadata and watch using embedded playback. YouTube video downloading is not supported.
summary.zh-CN: 保存 YouTube 链接及可获取的元数据，并通过内嵌播放器观看；不支持下载 YouTube 视频。

details.en: Implemented in development. YouTube links are played using the embedded player, not downloaded. Public availability is not yet confirmed.
details.zh-CN: 开发版本已实现，通过内嵌播放器观看 YouTube 链接，不提供下载。公开上线时间尚未确定。

releaseLabel.zh-CN: 开发已完成 · 待发布

summary.en: Preparing subscription access and purchase restoration for premium playback and timeline-note features.
summary.zh-CN: 正在完善高级播放与时间轴笔记等 Pro 功能的订阅解锁和恢复购买体验。

details.en: Subscription configuration and purchase/restore flows are being finalized and checked. The release date is not yet confirmed.
details.zh-CN: 正在完善订阅配置及购买、恢复购买流程，并进行检查。上线时间尚未确定。

summary.en: Traditional Chinese is planned in response to user requests. Availability will be confirmed in a future update.
summary.zh-CN: 已收到用户对繁体中文的需求，计划在后续版本支持，具体上线时间以更新公告为准。

details.en: Added to the roadmap following a user request. The release version and date will be confirmed when available.
details.zh-CN: 根据用户建议已列入开发计划，版本和上线时间确定后会更新。
